_note: Simulator parameters. basis: 'published' = taken from a source opened for docs/DOMAIN.md (ref = its reference number there); 'calibrated' = fitted to a real open dataset by research/scripts/calibrate_sim.py (never the dataset used to validate realism); 'assumption' = chosen by us (a ref then only supports the direction of the effect).

rhr_mean.note: Sleeping heart rate before flight 53.3 ± 7.3 bpm in 7 astronauts

rhr_between_sd.note: Between-astronaut SD of sleeping heart rate

rhr_within_sd.note: Fitted so simulated within-person SD matches 3.508 from Stanford wearables, people with no reported illness (calibration half), n = 74 people

rhr_ar1.note: Lag-1 autocorrelation 0.16 in Stanford wearables, people with no reported illness (calibration half), n = 74 people

lnhrv_within_sd.note: Fitted so simulated within-person SD matches 0.235 from LifeSnaps (calibration half), n = 21 people

spo2_within_sd.note: Fitted so simulated within-person SD matches 0.954 from LifeSnaps (calibration half), n = 13 people

temp_mean.note: Median overnight wrist skin temperature across people, LifeSnaps (calibration half)

temp_within_sd.note: Fitted so simulated within-person SD matches 0.476 from LifeSnaps nightly skin temperature (calibration half), n = 29 people

sleep_ground_mean.note: Post-flight actigraphy sleep 6.95 h on ISS missions, used as the ground value

sleep_within_sd.note: Fitted so simulated within-person SD matches 1.404 from LifeSnaps (calibration half), n = 28 people

ex_flight_min.note: NASA pages give two hours of exercise per day (2.5 h scheduled including setup), six days a week

mass_early_loss_frac.note: Body mass 2.8% to 4.4% below pre-flight, mostly within the first 30 days

flight_rhr_shift.note: Sleeping and daytime heart rate reported unchanged in flight; no bpm delta published

flight_rhr_shift_sd.note: Individual variation around the population shift

flight_lnhrv_shift.note: Direction (reduced HRV during sleep in flight) is published; the size is our assumption and a second study disagrees on direction

sms_incidence.note: Space motion sickness in 60-80% of travellers

co2_flight_mean.note: Typical mean ISS level not verified; published range is 1-9 mmHg

co2_effect_threshold.note: 7-day average below 2.5 mmHg keeps headache risk under 1%

headache_base.note: Headache probability at the 2.5 mmHg reference level (under 1% risk)

rad_ground.note: About 3 mSv per year natural background; not from an opened source

rad_transit.note: Measured inside the Mars Science Laboratory cruise vehicle

rad_lunar_surface.note: Chang'E-4 lander measurement, 1,369 microsievert per day

spe_peak_dose.note: Solar particles were about 3% of the cruise dose; the peak daily value is our choice, well under the 250 mSv event design limit

rhr_per_debt_h.unit: bpm per hour of sleep debt

rhr_per_ex_hour.unit: bpm per extra hour exercised the day before

pvt_per_debt_h.unit: ms per hour of sleep debt
pvt_per_debt_h.note: Direction (under 6 h sleep slows reaction) is published; slope is our assumption

illness_prodrome_days.note: Fitted to the mean resting-heart-rate change around 38 dated illness onsets (calibration half, Stanford phases 1 and 2)

illness_rhr_peak.note: Fitted peak of the mean resting-heart-rate change around 38 dated illness onsets (calibration half, Stanford phases 1 and 2). Observed per-episode quartiles -0.3 / 2.0 / 5.3 bpm; the published median among detected cases is 7 bpm (DOMAIN ref 58)

illness_lnhrv_drop.note: Direction (RMSSD down) is published; size is our assumption

illness_temp_peak.note: Fitted heart-rate peak divided by a second-hand 8.5 bpm per degree C (DOMAIN ref 60)

headache_odds_per_mmhg.note: Each +1 mmHg doubles the odds of a headache report

within_sd_person_sigma.note: Mean over five indicators of ln(Q3/Q1)/1.349 of the within-person SD across people (calibration halves)

illness_exercise_cut.note: Exercise reduction while symptomatic. Real step counts fall by about half after symptom onset in the Stanford data, but that includes isolating at home, so a smaller cut is assumed for a crew.

ex_missed_session_prob.note: Sessions lost to operations (maintenance, spacewalk days)

illness_rise_after_days.note: Days from symptom onset to the peak (same fit)

illness_magnitude_cv.note: Between-episode SD of the true response over its mean: observed SD 7.4 bpm, of which 2.3 bpm is measurement noise

noise_load_rhr.note: Loading on a shared day-to-day factor, from within-person correlations in LifeSnaps (calibration half, 20 people): heart rate with HRV -0.64, with skin temperature 0.20, with sleep -0.11

noise_load_lnhrv.note: Loading on a shared day-to-day factor, from within-person correlations in LifeSnaps (calibration half, 20 people): heart rate with HRV -0.64, with skin temperature 0.20, with sleep -0.11

noise_load_temp.note: Loading on a shared day-to-day factor, from within-person correlations in LifeSnaps (calibration half, 20 people): heart rate with HRV -0.64, with skin temperature 0.20, with sleep -0.11

noise_load_sleep.note: Loading on a shared day-to-day factor, from within-person correlations in LifeSnaps (calibration half, 20 people): heart rate with HRV -0.64, with skin temperature 0.20, with sleep -0.11
